name: linux-arm64-kvm-vcpu-events-v1
purpose: Evaluate rejected KVM_SET_VCPU_EVENTS atomicity in the complete ARM64 KVM guest.c translation unit and compare it with the candidate fix.

environment.command_policy: A one-entry database derived from the exact successful ARM64 Kbuild guest.c command was mapped onto the harness. The harness includes the complete selected guest.c; __kvm_arm_vcpu_set_events and commit_pending_events are unmodified source.

scenario.property: A rejected request leaves PC, PSTATE, and external-abort commit state unchanged.

model_boundaries: kvm_inject_sea marks PENDING_EXCEPTION and returns successful injection without using the fault address.
the modeled __kvm_adjust_pc HYP boundary changes PC to 512, PSTATE to 965, clears the pending flag, and records the commit
cpus_have_final_cap is true so rejection exercises the invalid ESR mask check rather than the unsupported-RAS check
the real commit_pending_events resets mmio_needed and invokes the modeled HYP boundary

measurements.name: patched-complete-guest-source
measurements.result: rejection and rejected_input_is_atomic are both valid

history.effect: The original userspace external-abort implementation validated SError fields before injecting the external abort.
The nested-SError refactor moved external-abort injection before SError validation; this is the candidate Fixes revision.
Pending exceptions from KVM_SET_VCPU_EVENTS began committing immediately to architectural state.

current_upstream_check.result: The commit-before-validation ordering was still present in the source crawled four days earlier.
current_upstream_check.public_search: Focused lore.kernel.org and source searches found no matching report or fix; this is not an exhaustive absence proof.

validation.reduced_before_fixed_ptests: passed in the complete kernel-checks suite before this measurement
validation.exact_baseline_control: passed with the expected invalid property
validation.validation_order_checker: revision 3d8d9df6a6 reports one finding in the baseline complete guest.c and none in the fixed complete guest.c
validation.validation_order_full_corpus: the final AST-only linux-arm64-kvm-v4 scan typed 83/83 exact command contexts and reported only this function
validation.linux_patch_checkpatch: passed previously with zero errors, warnings, or checks

candidate_disposition.status: exact-source static violation; runtime and maintainer confirmation pending

limitations: The exception injection and HYP commit are bounded models of cross-translation-unit and privilege-boundary effects.
The scenario proves one combined invalid request; it does not verify every KVM_SET_VCPU_EVENTS input or outcome.
The UAPI documents -EINVAL for invalid SError fields but does not explicitly state transaction atomicity.
ARM64 runtime reproduction and upstream maintainer review remain necessary before treating the candidate as confirmed.
interpretation: Unlike the earlier reduced replay, this differential executes the real baseline and patched __kvm_arm_vcpu_set_events implementations inside complete exact-Kbuild guest.c translation units. It materially strengthens the candidate but does not convert it into a confirmed upstream bug.
